headline: Bitcoin Holds Near 82k as Spot Funds Shed $487 Million and Greed Runs Ahead of a Flat Cycle
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487 million on the Oct. 7 print, ether funds lost $160.8 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin trades near 82k after a 1.4% decline. Fear and greed reads 57, labeled greed, while the cycle index sits flat at 56 in complacency, so sentiment is running ahead of the cash leaving the funds and the cycle score. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short print, the dollar is firm at 102.49, and volatility is quiet, with the VIX at 15.21 and seven-day realized volatility at 29.09% against 50.44% over thirty days, so the outflow is meeting shorts rather than a leverage chase or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
